tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List every backend service exposed to MCP, with a one-line description and the method names each offers. Call this first when you do not already know what is available.

tools.name: describe_service
tools.title: Describe a service
tools.description: Return method signatures for one service — parameter names, types, whether they are required, and the return shape. Required reading before calling an unfamiliar method, because call_service takes POSITIONAL arguments.

service.description: Service class name exactly as returned by list_services (e.g. "PayrollRunEngineService").

tools.name: call_service
tools.title: Call a service method
tools.description: Invoke a method on a registered service. REQUIRES AUTHENTICATION: the request must carry an `orgid` header and an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header, and the caller needs content permissions in that org. Unlike list_services/describe_service, this one will refuse without them. A token comes from POST /user/signin (body: email, password, with the orgid header) or from an org API key. Arguments are POSITIONAL, in declaration order, with orgId omitted — the server injects orgId and the current user from the authenticated session, and passing your own would be ignored. For a method declared (orgId, body) pass args: [body]; for (orgId, input, author) pass args: [input, author]. Service errors are returned verbatim so you can read them and adjust.

method.description: Method name. Must be marked @AiCallable or the call is rejected.

args.description: Positional arguments in declared order, with orgId omitted.
